about: The wings of the hospital block and the buildings around it, by hand from the documents (docs/twin/PLAN.md §1). parts: the numbers tools/wingparts.py gives the parts of the 1:1000 site plan 534362efe171 p1 (largest first). osm: the OSM buildings these parts replace. sure: false where the documents do not settle which part is which. built: years and what was done, from the DIVE analysis 3957fafe78ec unless noted. Part 14 (a strip west of the high-rise) is the 2002 parking deck with legevakt (OSM 1163588204), which stays as it is. levels: each wing's storeys and their kote; how: 'tegning' (read off the drawing in src), 'beregnet' (worked out as src says), 'antatt' (assumed, src says from what).
